sentences.en: The bio luminescence turned the sea an eerie glow.
sentences.zh: 1. 生物发光让大海呈现出一种阴森的光芒。

sentences.en: The snow on Lulu Island seems eerie and unearthly.
sentences.zh: 2. 卢卢岛上的雪看起来怪异而超凡脱俗。

sentences.en: The eerie silence struck terror into their hearts.
sentences.zh: 3. 那种阴森的寂静令他们心生恐惧。
